label: Historical transaction-cost schedule for ETF delivery trades on BSE and NSE, 2018 onward
about: Every component that may apply to a simulated ETF delivery trade, with where it applies, what it is charged on, and its dated periods. A period is used only if verified against a primary source cited in it. On 2026-10-28 no component has a verified rate for the study window: the primary sources are blocked, not located or not retrieved (india/cost_tax_sources.json). Each component therefore has no periods and is unresolved, which the cost model reports as unresolved, never as zero. 'applies' records the working assumption of where a charge falls; applicability_verified says whether a primary source has confirmed it.

partial_evidence.fact: CDSL charges a DP a flat Rs 3.50 per debit transaction with effect from 2024-10-01, with an additional Rs 0.25 discount for Mutual Funds ISINs and for female first holders
partial_evidence.why_not_a_rate: it is the depository's charge to the DP, not the client-facing DP charge, which the broker sets; whether ETF units count as Mutual Funds ISINs is not stated; no tariff before 2024-10-01 was located

components.unresolved_reason: the client-facing DP charge is the broker's; no dated broker schedule and no depository tariff before 2024-10-01
